lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 我们下个月要招聘一名运营专员。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xià gè yuè yào zhāopìn yì míng yùnyíng zhuānyuán.
lines.en: Next month we need to hire one operations specialist.

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 这个岗位最重要的三项工作是什么？
lines.pinyin: Zhège gǎngwèi zuì zhòngyào de sān xiàng gōngzuò shì shénme?
lines.en: What are the three most important tasks for this role?

lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 主要是排班、整理数据和跨部门沟通。
lines.pinyin: Zhǔyào shì páibān, zhěnglǐ shùjù hé kuà bùmén gōutōng.
lines.en: Mainly scheduling, cleaning up data, and cross-team communication.

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 经验和语言要求也需要写清楚吗？
lines.pinyin: Jīngyàn hé yǔyán yāoqiú yě xūyào xiě qīngchu ma?
lines.en: Do we also need to spell out experience and language requirements?

lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 对，工作中需要经常用中文沟通。
lines.pinyin: Duì, gōngzuò zhōng xūyào jīngcháng yòng Zhōngwén gōutōng.
lines.en: Yes — this job often requires communicating in Mandarin.

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 我先整理岗位要求，再发给你确认。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zhěnglǐ gǎngwèi yāoqiú, zài fā gěi nǐ quèrèn.
lines.en: I’ll draft the job requirements first, then send them for you to confirm.

lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 好，确认后再发布。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, quèrèn hòu zài fābù.
lines.en: Okay — post it after it’s confirmed.

lines.speaker: 面试官
lines.zh: 你好，请先简单介绍一下自己。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐng xiān jiǎndān jièshào yíxià zìjǐ.
lines.en: Hi — please introduce yourself briefly first.

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 你好。我做过运营和数据整理方面的项目。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Wǒ zuòguo yùnyíng hé shùjù zhěnglǐ fāngmiàn de xiàngmù.
lines.en: Hello. I’ve done operations and data-cleanup projects.

lines.speaker: 面试官
lines.zh: 你在其中具体负责什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài qízhōng jùtǐ fùzé shénme?
lines.en: On that project, what were you specifically responsible for?

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 我负责整理每周数据，并向团队汇报结果。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fùzé zhěnglǐ měi zhōu shùjù, bìng xiàng tuánduì huìbào jiéguǒ.
lines.en: I cleaned up the weekly data and reported the results to the team.

lines.speaker: 面试官
lines.zh: 遇到数据不一致时，你怎么处理？
lines.pinyin: Yùdào shùjù bù yízhì shí, nǐ zěnme chǔlǐ?
lines.en: When the data was inconsistent, how did you handle it?

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 我会先核对来源，再和相关同事确认。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān héduì láiyuán, zài hé xiāngguān tóngshì quèrèn.
lines.en: I’d check the source first, then confirm with the relevant colleague.

lines.speaker: 面试官
lines.zh: 明白。最后，你有什么问题想问我们？
lines.pinyin: Míngbai. Zuìhòu, nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí xiǎng wèn wǒmen?
lines.en: Understood. Finally, what would you like to ask us?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 周一上午九点请到前台报到。
lines.pinyin: Zhōuyī shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn qǐng dào qiántái bàodào.
lines.en: Please check in at reception at 9 a.m. on Monday.

lines.speaker: 新同事
lines.zh: 好的。需要带哪些材料？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Xūyào dài nǎxiē cáiliào?
lines.en: Okay. Which materials do I need to bring?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 我会发一份清单，请按清单准备。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì fā yí fèn qīngdān, qǐng àn qīngdān zhǔnbèi.
lines.en: I’ll send a checklist — please prepare according to it.

lines.speaker: 新同事
lines.zh: 入职当天就能登录系统吗？
lines.pinyin: Rùzhí dāngtiān jiù néng dēnglù xìtǒng ma?
lines.en: Can I log into the systems on day one?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 权限开通后可以登录，我会通知你。
lines.pinyin: Quánxiàn kāitōng hòu kěyǐ dēnglù, wǒ huì tōngzhī nǐ.
lines.en: You can log in after access is opened — I’ll notify you.

lines.speaker: 新同事
lines.zh: 如果有问题，我该联系谁？
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu wèntí, wǒ gāi liánxì shéi?
lines.en: If there’s a problem, who should I contact?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 先联系我，工作流程的问题可以问带教同事。
lines.pinyin: Xiān liánxì wǒ, gōngzuò liúchéng de wèntí kěyǐ wèn dàijiào tóngshì.
lines.en: Contact me first; for workflow questions, you can ask your buddy mentor.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 我们先看这个月的目标和实际进展。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān kàn zhège yuè de mùbiāo hé shíjì jìnzhǎn.
lines.en: Let’s look at this month’s goals and the actual progress first.

lines.speaker: 员工
lines.zh: 大部分任务完成了，但交接有点慢。
lines.pinyin: Dà bùfen rènwu wánchéng le, dàn jiāojiē yǒudiǎn màn.
lines.en: Most tasks are done, but handoffs have been a bit slow.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 我也注意到了。你觉得主要卡在哪里？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhùyì dào le. Nǐ juéde zhǔyào kǎ zài nǎlǐ?
lines.en: I noticed that too. Where do you think the main bottleneck is?

lines.speaker: 员工
lines.zh: 有些信息没有及时同步。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xìnxī méiyǒu jíshí tóngbù.
lines.en: Some information wasn’t synced in time.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 那我们试一下每天更新一次交接表。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen shì yíxià měi tiān gēngxīn yí cì jiāojiē biǎo.
lines.en: Then let’s try updating the handoff sheet once a day.

lines.speaker: 员工
lines.zh: 可以。我周五汇报一下效果。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Wǒ Zhōuwǔ huìbào yíxià xiàoguǒ.
lines.en: Yes. I will report how it went on Friday.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 好，我会根据结果再给你反馈。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ huì gēnjù jiéguǒ zài gěi nǐ fǎnkuì.
lines.en: Okay. I will give you feedback again based on the result.

dialogues.label: SIMULASI 05
dialogues.headingEn: Requesting leave and handing over work

lines.speaker: 员工
lines.zh: 我想下周三请一天假，可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xià Zhōusān qǐng yì tiān jià, kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: I’d like to take next Wednesday off — is that okay?

lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 可以先在系统提交申请。那天的工作怎么安排？
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ xiān zài xìtǒng tíjiāo shēnqǐng. Nà tiān de gōngzuò zěnme ānpái?
lines.en: Submit the request in the system first. How will that day’s work be covered?

lines.speaker: 员工
lines.zh: 我会提前完成报告，客户事项交接给小李。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì tíqián wánchéng bàogào, kèhù shìxiàng jiāojiē gěi Xiǎo Lǐ.
lines.en: I’ll finish the report early and hand client matters to Xiao Li.

lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 请先和小李确认，他那天是否有空。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng xiān hé Xiǎo Lǐ quèrèn, tā nà tiān shìfǒu yǒu kòng.
lines.en: Please confirm with Xiao Li first whether he’s free that day.

lines.speaker: 员工
lines.zh: 好的，确认后我会在群里同步。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, quèrèn hòu wǒ huì zài qún lǐ tóngbù.
lines.en: Okay — after confirming, I’ll sync it in the group chat.

lines.speaker: 主管
lines.zh: 审批结果出来后再告诉我一声。
lines.pinyin: Shěnpī jiéguǒ chūlai hòu zài gàosu wǒ yì shēng.
lines.en: Once the approval result is out, tell me again.

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 我们先把事实和各自的理解分开说。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān bǎ shìshí hé gèzì de lǐjiě fēnkāi shuō.
lines.en: Let’s separate the facts from each person’s understanding first.

lines.speaker: 同事甲
lines.zh: 我以为周报由乙负责，所以没有更新。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhōubào yóu Yǐ fùzé, suǒyǐ méiyǒu gēngxīn.
lines.en: I thought B owned the weekly report, so I didn’t update it.

lines.speaker: 同事乙
lines.zh: 我理解的是我只负责提供数据。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lǐjiě de shì wǒ zhǐ fùzé tígōng shùjù.
lines.en: My understanding was that I was only responsible for providing data.

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 明白。我们看看上次会议的分工记录。
lines.pinyin: Míngbai. Wǒmen kànkan shàng cì huìyì de fēngōng jìlù.
lines.en: Got it. Let’s look at the task-split notes from the last meeting.

lines.speaker: 同事甲
lines.zh: 记录里写得不够清楚。
lines.pinyin: Jìlù lǐ xiě de bú gòu qīngchu.
lines.en: The notes aren’t clear enough.

lines.speaker: 同事乙
lines.zh: 那这次我们把负责人和截止时间写明白。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhè cì wǒmen bǎ fùzérén hé jiézhǐ shíjiān xiě míngbai.
lines.en: Then this time let’s write the owner and deadline clearly.

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 好，先解决这周的报告，再调整交接方式。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, xiān jiějué zhè zhōu de bàogào, zài tiáozhěng jiāojiē fāngshì.
lines.en: Okay — finish this week’s report first, then adjust the handoff method.

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 请问这份录用通知写的是税前月薪吗？
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè fèn lùyòng tōngzhī xiě de shì shuìqián yuèxīn ma?
lines.en: Does this offer letter state pre-tax monthly salary?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 是的，固定薪资和奖金是分开列出的。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, gùdìng xīnzī hé jiǎngjīn shì fēnkāi lièchū de.
lines.en: Yes — base pay and bonus are listed separately.

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 奖金的发放条件在哪里可以看到？
lines.pinyin: Jiǎngjīn de fāfàng tiáojiàn zài nǎlǐ kěyǐ kàndào?
lines.en: Where can I see the bonus payout conditions?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 附件里有说明，你也可以把不清楚的地方列给我。
lines.pinyin: Fùjiàn lǐ yǒu shuōmíng, nǐ yě kěyǐ bǎ bù qīngchu de dìfang liè gěi wǒ.
lines.en: There’s an explanation in the attachment; you can also send me a list of unclear points.

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 社保和公积金的安排也在附件里吗？
lines.pinyin: Shèbǎo hé gōngjījīn de ānpái yě zài fùjiàn lǐ ma?
lines.en: Are social insurance and housing fund arrangements also in the attachment?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 相关信息会以正式文件为准，我把对应页面发给你。
lines.pinyin: Xiāngguān xìnxī huì yǐ zhèngshì wénjiàn wéi zhǔn, wǒ bǎ duìyìng yèmiàn fā gěi nǐ.
lines.en: The official documents govern; I’ll send you the relevant pages.

lines.speaker: 候选人
lines.zh: 好的，我看完再统一回复。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ kàn wán zài tǒngyī huífù.
lines.en: Okay — I’ll reply with one response after I read it.

dialogues.label: SIMULASI 08
dialogues.headingEn: Reporting a problem and proposing training

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 本月新同事的培训进展怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Běn yuè xīn tóngshì de péixùn jìnzhǎn zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How is new-hire training progress this month?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 入职流程已经完成，但系统实操还不够熟练。
lines.pinyin: Rùzhí liúchéng yǐjīng wánchéng, dàn xìtǒng shícāo hái bú gòu shúliàn.
lines.en: Onboarding is complete, but hands-on system practice still isn’t fluent enough.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 原因确定了吗？
lines.pinyin: Yuányīn quèdìng le ma?
lines.en: Has the cause been confirmed?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 还没有。我先核对培训记录，再问带教同事。
lines.pinyin: Hái méiyǒu. Wǒ xiān héduì péixùn jìlù, zài wèn dàijiào tóngshì.
lines.en: Not yet. I’ll check the training records first, then ask the buddy mentor.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 如果确实需要补课，你建议怎么做？
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ quèshí xūyào bǔkè, nǐ jiànyì zěnme zuò?
lines.en: If we really need a catch-up session, what do you suggest?

lines.speaker: HR
lines.zh: 建议先做一次实操练习，下周再评估效果。
lines.pinyin: Jiànyì xiān zuò yí cì shícāo liànxí, xià zhōu zài pínggū xiàoguǒ.
lines.en: I suggest one hands-on practice first, then evaluate the result next week.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 可以。请把计划、负责人和时间写清楚。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Qǐng bǎ jìhuà, fùzérén hé shíjiān xiě qīngchu.
lines.en: Okay. Please write the plan, owner, and timing clearly.

notes.title: Eight workplace simulations
notes.body: Workplace dialogues, simulations 01–08 (pages 85–92). The Chinese is from the book. The English is the meaning of those lines.

notes.title: Copy this — simulation 01
notes.body: A safe order: state the need, confirm the requirements, then publish. 先…再… keeps that work order.

notes.title: Copy this — simulation 02
notes.body: 具体负责什么 separates what you personally did from the team project. A strong answer names actions, not only personal qualities.

notes.title: Yang perlu kamu tiru — SIMULASI 03
notes.body: 权限开通后才… menjaga ekspektasi. Menyebut satu kontak utama mencegah rekan baru terombang-ambing.

notes.title: Copy this — simulation 04
notes.body: Order: facts, then the cause, then what you tried, then a review date. Avoid personal labels such as 'you are careless'.

notes.title: Copy this — simulation 05
notes.body: 请假 is a request. Submitting it, confirming the handover, and the approval result are three different statuses. Read it once, close the page, then say the dialogue again with one new detail: the day, the number of candidates, the priority, or the reason.

notes.title: Copy this — simulation 06
notes.body: 我以为… states an assumption, not a fact. Check it against the record before you decide who was wrong.

notes.title: Copy this — simulation 07
notes.body: Ask about before-tax and after-tax pay, fixed parts, bonus, and the conditions separately. Do not guess the whole package from one total.
